entries.name: Succubus Invasions
entries.content: Succuba Invasions- Succuba may encroach on another Succuba's claimed victim, rising from a nearby surface with materializing symbols. Depending on the personality of the succuba, they may join together in draining the victim or fight to keep the victim to themself. Succuba materialize and invade when there are multiple characters in a chat. Cooperative Succuba are willing to share, Competitive Succuba may tussle over a victim.

entries.name: Succubus Powers
entries.content: Succuba Abilities: Succuba are capable of supernatural feats- every one of them equipped with the abilities of Hemomancy, Teleportation, & supernatural healing. Hemomancy is the psychic manipulation of blood, Succuba use this power to force erections in unwilling victims. Fortunately, their hemomantic abilities are weak, & only utilized to force erection, nothing more. Succuba can additionally teleport between the earthen realm and their own, the succuba realm, though not often or across short distances, as it takes much energy. Succuba also have a healing factor, the ability to close & heal wounds at supernatural speed. This factor speeds up when consuming semen. For a succuba to activate their power, they must hold up the palm of their hand, where a red collection of fiery runes will appear- as long as they have the intent to use their powers. Then, the spectral runes dissipate, their conjuration activating. Greater succuba also often have additional powers alongside their normal ones. Succuba powers can be dampened through exorcist rites- holy sigils, salt circles, holy water, silver, etc.

entries.name: Succubus Behavior
entries.content:
Succuba Behavior: Succuba operate on hunting grounds or turfs for their feeding. Often times, Succuba will claim multiple victims to rotate between as victims take time to replenish sperm. Succuba are fiercely protective of their claimed victims as when opposing succuba encroach on their turf & victims, the drained victims produce less climax for the claiming succuba, often resulting in turf disputes between succuba, solved through physicality. Succuba are categorized by rankings, ranging from D to S; D rank being the lowest, & S rank being the highest. 

-D rank succuba often have claims over one or two victims, & are often having their turf disputed & taken over by opposing succuba. D rank succuba are very easy to stave off by victims through the simplest of banishing rites

-C rank succuba often have claims over one to three victims, though maintain their turf more often then not.

-B rank succuba often have up to ten victims they rotate between, & have to stave off stronger succuba regularly from encroaching on their turf.

-A rank succuba are often very successful, picking up to fifty particularly virile victims to rotate between & are very rarely involved in turf disputes. Additionally, A rank succuba often have additional powers to their normal succubus abilities. A rank succuba are more immune to banishing rites than the average succubus.

-S rank succuba are steeped in rumor & myths, their existence rarely documented, though when they are, it's often accompanied with disaster. S rank succuba are threats to entire civilizations, draining entire villages or cities in a warpath of hunger. S rank succuba are also prone to murderous tendencies, their disregard for human life increased tenfold as their turf is wherever they damn well please. They are completely immune to banishment, only able to be restrained, & are very powerful physically as well as mentally. An S rank succuba is treated with the same amount of caution & fear as a dragon or a nuke.

entries.name: The Exorcist Guild
entries.content:
The Guild of Exorcists:
The guild of exorcists is an organization in the mortal realm that specializes in exorcising succuba, mainly to prevent chaos & rid those afflicted of being within a succuba's hunting grounds of their woes. Exorcists are typically intimidating enough to send most succuba packing, but Succuba C-rank & above offer resistance. Within the guild, exorcists have differing factions, roles & seniority. Most exorcists are as good as intimidating thugs, though very few are capable of warding off even A-rank succuba through sheer might, will & battle prowess. Very high ranking, senior exorcists often assume the honorific 'Pontifex', to recognize their unmatched prowess in exorcism. Exorcist Guild members of any lower rank & standing have an unyielding reverence for Pontifices, showing great courtesy, respect, & handling their presence with great care. Succuba, on the other hand, feel unfathomable dread & terror when sensing a pontifex nearby, no matter how crass or tough they might be.

They may take on the appearance of wolves, cows, sheep, snakes etc. None are known to resemble humans at all. Succuba are supernatural creatures, hyperspecialized to draw nutrition from human ejaculate / semen. entries.name: Succubus Birthrite
entries.content: Succuba Birth Rite: Succuba are originally fruits that grow on trees in the succuba realm. These fruits take thousands of years to ripen, and once they do, they can be plucked and begin the preparation process. The Succuba Fruit is fermented in specialized jars after picking, large jars filled and mixed with many different manners of materials. The materials the fruit is fermented with often decide the Succuba's physical attributes and personality. The fruit must ferment, gestating for decades, over the course of which the pulp will swell and take on a unique color. Once the fruit is properly fermented, it becomes veiny with fleshy tubes protruding from it. During the birthing rite itself, the fruit must be inserted into a relatively fresh human corpse, supplanting the heart. As the fruit takes hold within the corpse, the corpse begins to shift and change as it takes the form of a newly born succuba. The succuba will assume the gender of the host it was birthed with, though will take on no other aspects of the corpse. The succuba always emerges sexually and intelectually mature, if a bit naive.

Most importantly, they become the best defense against Succuba; Their penis transforms, becoming porous & adapting to hit succuba pressure points, illiciting pleasure or debilitating discomfort. entries.name: Succuba Realm
entries.content: The Succuba Realm- originally thought to be a separate dimension, was discovered in recent times to be a sprawling cavern deep below the earth. Its origins are steeped in mystery- though it is believed that at some point, when the first succuba had appeared, they migrated underground to cultivate their species, and congregate where no human dared tread.
